key.flyingeaves.compose: Single building: draw rooms / room table
flyingeaves.tool.draw.hint: Right-click two opposite corners; each new room must touch an existing one; left-click removes the last
flyingeaves.tool.round.hint: Right-click two opposite corners; the round tower fits in that box (diameter = the shorter side); left-click removes the last
flyingeaves.tool.move.hint: Scroll to move the room along your view (scroll up = forward); hold Ctrl to move it up or down
flyingeaves.tool.shape.hint: Scroll to change this room's shape: rectangle, round tower, and the shapes room settings can't make: paifang, screen wall, wall gate, glazed gate, festooned gate, palace wall, paving, river bridge, ornament, terrace, street, stone stairs, stone bridge, ground patch (16 in all)
flyingeaves.tool.stack.hint: Scroll to add or remove storeys
flyingeaves.tool.gateway.hint: Scroll to set the gateways through a city-wall podium: auto (by its width), none, one, three, five
flyingeaves.tool.stackon.hint: Scroll to switch between on the ground and stacked on the room below (a box drawn inside another room stacks by itself)
flyingeaves.tool.height.hint: Scroll to set this room's storey height (4–16 blocks; below 4 it goes back to auto)
flyingeaves.tool.taper.hint: Scroll to set how far each storey steps in on every side (0 none, 1–3): towers and pavilions get smaller going up
flyingeaves.tool.pingzuo.hint: Scroll to toggle balconies (pingzuo): a railed walkway round every upper floor of a round tower, on the eave below (like the Yingxian Pagoda); round towers of 2+ storeys only
flyingeaves.tool.podium.hint: Scroll to set the podium height (none, 1–12 blocks); hold Ctrl to change its style: platform, Sumeru podium, three tiers, city-wall podium (with gateways, for gate towers)
flyingeaves.tool.podshape.hint: Scroll to change the podium shape: follow (square under a room, round under a round tower), square (a square base under a round tower, a city-wall podium), round (a round altar under a square hall); needs a podium
flyingeaves.tool.steps.hint: Scroll to set the slope of the steps in front of the podium (or terrace): 45° one block a step; 27°, 18°, 14° gentler half-slab steps that reach further out; needs a podium; a city-wall podium has none
flyingeaves.tool.margin.hint: Scroll to set how many blocks you can walk between the wall foot and the podium edge: auto (one, wider where sills and door lamps stick out), 1–4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20 (triple terraces, altars, big city-wall podiums)
flyingeaves.tool.base.hint: Scroll to change the podium and foundation material (stone bricks, same as the wall base, grey brick, white stone…)
flyingeaves.tool.use.hint: Scroll to change what the floor under the crosshair is used for (Empty: nothing in it); right-click for a list
flyingeaves.tool.interior.hint: Scroll to toggle the whole building's interior: on (furniture, lamps), off (walls, partitions, stairs and ladders only; rooms left empty); no need to aim at a room
flyingeaves.tool.roof.hint: Scroll to change the roof; Shift+right-click for a list
flyingeaves.tool.eave.hint: Scroll to switch single, double and triple eaves (one or two more rings of eaves below the roof)
flyingeaves.tool.pitch.hint: Scroll to set the roof pitch: auto, gentle, medium, steep, very steep (great halls are steep)
flyingeaves.tool.eaveout.hint: Scroll to set how far the eaves reach past the walls: auto, short, medium, long, very long
flyingeaves.tool.lift.hint: Scroll to set how far the eave corners curl up: auto, none, small, medium, large
flyingeaves.tool.zoushou.hint: Scroll to set the little beasts on each hip ridge: auto, none, 3, 5, 7, 9 (led by an immortal)
flyingeaves.tool.dougong.hint: Scroll to set the brackets (dougong) under the eaves: auto, none, one, two, three tiers (more tiers lift the eaves higher and further out)
flyingeaves.tool.caihua.hint: Scroll to change the painted beams (caihua): none, Xuanzi, Hexi, Suzhou style
flyingeaves.tool.walls.hint: Scroll to change the walls; Shift+right-click for a list
flyingeaves.tool.baystyle.hint: Scroll to change this room's windows and wall bays (random, small window, lattice window, lattice door, bar window, ornamental window…)
flyingeaves.tool.theme.hint: Scroll to change the roof tiles; Shift+right-click for a list
flyingeaves.tool.gallery.hint: Scroll to switch none, front, back, front and back (a row of eave posts under a lean-to roof), all round (a walkway on all four sides)
flyingeaves.tool.gable.hint: Scroll to switch plain gables and horse-head walls (Huizhou style, stepped up above the roof)
flyingeaves.tool.open.hint: Scroll to switch closed, open front (a stage), open all round (posts and low rails only: a pavilion), passage (the back opened through, no ground-floor partitions: a gate hall); hold Ctrl for the entrances: front, front and back (halls on an axis, gate halls), four sides (square halls)
flyingeaves.tool.flooropen.hint: Scroll to set the floor under the crosshair: as room (follows Openness), closed, open front, open all round, passage (a stage: ground floor open in front, upper floors closed)
flyingeaves.tool.palette.hint: Right-click a room to set up the material board in front of you: put blocks into its cells to change that part's material; right-click the room again to save, left-click to cancel
flyingeaves.tool.reroll.hint: Scroll on a room: restyle just that room; hold Ctrl: just its roof; not aiming at a room: the whole building. Scroll back to return to earlier looks
flyingeaves.tool.copy.hint: Shift+right-click to remember a room's style (roof, walls, bay style, tiles, storey height, look); right-click another room to copy it there
flyingeaves.tool.delete.hint: Right-click to delete the room under the crosshair
flyingeaves.compose.start: New building: right-click two opposite corners to draw a room; Alt+scroll switches tools; Ctrl+Z undoes; %s opens the room table
flyingeaves.compose.too_big: Room too big (at most %s blocks a side)
flyingeaves.compose.not_touching: This room doesn't touch the others: one building at a time, so a new room must share a stretch of wall with an existing room or overlap it
flyingeaves.compose.stacked_tower: Tower %s stacked on room %s (that roof is cut flat at its walls into a balcony); to put it on the ground: room table, Stack → Ground
flyingeaves.compose.stacked_room: Room %s stacked on room %s (that roof is cut flat at its walls into a balcony); to put it on the ground: room table, Stack → Ground
flyingeaves.compose.added_slope: , on the highest ground in the box; the low side is %s blocks lower (filled with a stone base, steps at the door; Ctrl+scroll moves it up or down)
flyingeaves.compose.random_building: Random building: one %s×%s box, %s room(s), every setting random; click again (or press %s) for another, Ctrl+Z to go back
flyingeaves.compose.sect_loaded: Random sect: %s, %s buildings, %s rooms (terraces, stairs and streets are rooms too, each editable); %sclick again for another, Ctrl+Z to go back
flyingeaves.compose.town_loaded: Random town: %s, %s buildings, %s rooms (streets and terraces are rooms too, each editable); %sclick again for another, Ctrl+Z to go back
flyingeaves.compose.on_terrain: laid out on the terrain here;
flyingeaves.compose.city_loaded: %s: %s rooms (halls, walls, gates, river and paving are all rooms, each editable), %s×%s blocks; the Meridian Gate is at the crosshair facing you, all of it on the ground at the crosshair's level (higher ground cut away, dips filled); %spress %s for the room table and Generate: over a minute to generate, about another to write into the world
flyingeaves.compose.no_preview_frames: too big for a preview, see the frames;
flyingeaves.compose.court_loaded: Random courtyard: %s, %s rooms (halls, side wings, walls, gates and paving are all rooms, each editable); click again for another, Ctrl+Z to go back
flyingeaves.compose.recipe_wings: , with porches on all four sides
flyingeaves.compose.undo: Undone (%s more steps can be undone)
flyingeaves.compose.redo: Redone (%s more steps can be redone)
flyingeaves.compose.board_cancelled: Material board put away, nothing changed
flyingeaves.compose.no_room_aimed: Not aiming at a room (aim at a wireframe)
flyingeaves.compose.copied: Remembered room %s's style; right-click another room to copy it there
flyingeaves.compose.pasted: Room %s now has the remembered style
flyingeaves.compose.interior_off: Interior: off (rooms left empty; stairs and ladders kept)
flyingeaves.compose.first_corner: First corner: %s, %s; now right-click the opposite corner
flyingeaves.why.stackon: No room below (to stack it, draw it inside an earlier room)
flyingeaves.why.pingzuo_round: Only round towers have balconies (make it a round tower with Shape first)
flyingeaves.why.pingzuo_storeys: Balconies are upstairs: the tower needs 2+ storeys (add one with Storeys first)
flyingeaves.why.no_podium: No podium yet: scroll one up with Podium first
flyingeaves.why.chengtai_steps: A city-wall podium has no steps (you go through its gateways): step slopes are for platforms, Sumeru podiums and three tiers
flyingeaves.why.gateway: Gateways go through a city-wall podium: switch the podium style to it first (Ctrl+scroll with Podium)
flyingeaves.why.beasts: Ridge beasts sit on hip ridges: hip-and-gable, hip, pyramidal, flat-topped hip and cross-ridge roofs only (or the lower eave of double eaves)
flyingeaves.why.gable: Only flush-gable and overhanging-gable roofs have gable walls: switch to one for horse-head walls
flyingeaves.why.floor_open_round: Round towers can't set openness floor by floor (use Openness for the whole room)
flyingeaves.say.no_podium: No podium: the ground floor sits on the ground
flyingeaves.say.wall_taper: Taper: both wall faces step in %s blocks going up (city walls with a frame 7+ blocks deep)
flyingeaves.say.taper: Taper: %s in on every side a storey
flyingeaves.hud.keys: Alt+scroll: tools · Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Y redo · %s room table · %s random building
flyingeaves.gen.room_too_big: Room %s is too big (%s×%s): at most %s blocks a side
flyingeaves.compose.title: Single building
flyingeaves.screen.name: Name
flyingeaves.screen.sentence_cn_only: Sentences are Chinese only for now (e.g. 重檐歇山大殿，高 30 格)
flyingeaves.screen.town_size_bad: Town width and depth must be whole numbers above 0 (blocks), or leave both empty to size it by its scale
flyingeaves.screen.howto_text: One building at a time. Close this panel to go back to the world: right-click one corner on the ground, then the opposite corner, and that is a room (a wireframe); the Draw tower tool draws round towers. Each further room must share a wall with an existing room or overlap it; rooms that touch get doors between them. Alt+scroll switches tools; scroll or click on a room to use them; Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y redoes. You can also click Random building (or press %1$s in the world, again for another) or load a preset under Save / Load (the random palace city and the 1:1 Forbidden City are in the preset library under Palace city). Typing a sentence on the left works in Chinese only for now. When the rooms are drawn, press %2$s to come back and fine-tune, then click Generate.
flyingeaves.screen.applied_all: Every room now has room %s's roof, walls, bay style, tiles, storey height, podium and base
flyingeaves.screen.default_set: From now on the first room you draw takes room %s's style (roof, walls, bay style, tiles, storeys, storey height, podium, uses)
flyingeaves.screen.default_cleared: Default style cleared: the first room you draw starts with 1 storey and the default materials
flyingeaves.pick.shape: Shape (paifang, gates, walls, paving, river bridges, ornaments: what room settings can't make)
flyingeaves.pick.base: Base material (podium, the stone under the house, foundations on slopes)
flyingeaves.pick.floor_open: Floor %s openness (As room = follows Openness above)
flyingeaves.designs.lib_hint: Presets: every setting is inside; load one and keep editing
flyingeaves.designs.mine_hint: “folder/name” saves into a folder; all is autosaved (in progress: “Autosave”)
flyingeaves.designs.mine_empty: No saves here yet. Draw some rooms, give them a name and click Save this building.
flyingeaves.designs.loaded: Loaded “%s”: %s room(s) at the crosshair; move it with the Move tool, press %s to fine-tune
flyingeaves.build.busy: The last building is still generating, wait a moment
flyingeaves.build.sampling: Reading the terrain… (%s×%s blocks; chunks not generated yet are generated now)
flyingeaves.build.site_city: Laying out a palace city… (it's big: the preview takes about a minute)
flyingeaves.build.site_city_real: Laying out the Forbidden City 1:1… (about 780×1070 blocks, 575 rooms)
flyingeaves.build.site_town_sized: Laying out a %s×%s town… (on the terrain here; bigger takes longer, a few minutes for hundreds of blocks across)
flyingeaves.build.site_town: Laying out a town… (on the terrain here; the preview takes 10–20 seconds)

flyingeaves.build.silent_minute: No word from the generator for a minute (%s)
flyingeaves.build.recognized: Recognized: %s; everything can be changed in the room table
flyingeaves.build.undo_queued: Undo queued: %s building(s) still being written first

flyingeaves.menu.title: Build
flyingeaves.menu.pick_first: Pick a building on the left first
flyingeaves.menu.no_ground: Not aiming at the ground (300 blocks at most)
flyingeaves.menu.choose_text: Search on the left or browse by group. Then pick a tier and a seed here and place it where the crosshair points.
flyingeaves.menu.place_note: Takes a few seconds. Big ones (main halls, market streets, sect sites) span 100+ blocks: stand back. Enter places too.
flyingeaves.board.started: The material board is in front of you: front row walls, back row roof. Put a block in a cell to change that part; right-click the room again to save, left-click to cancel
flyingeaves.board.empty: Nothing on the board, nothing changed
flyingeaves.board.saved: Saved%s; this room uses them now (flyingeaves/materials/custom.json)
flyingeaves.board.hud: Material board: put blocks in the cells to change materials · right-click the room to save · left-click to cancel
flyingeaves.cmd.pos_first: Mark two opposite corners first with /flyingeaves part pos1 and pos2
flyingeaves.cmd.bad_role: The role must be window, door, plain or shop
flyingeaves.cmd.bay_too_big: Box too big: a wall bay is at most 8 wide, 12 high, 2 thick (the wall and outside it)
flyingeaves.cmd.no_style: Can't read the materials of wall style %s (is the generator running?): %s
flyingeaves.cmd.bay_saved: Saved the wall bay: %s (%s, %s wide, %s high) → %s
flyingeaves.cmd.pos_first_ornament: Mark it first with /flyingeaves part pos1 (the block the ornament sits on) and pos2 (the opposite corner)

flyingeaves.cmd.empty_box: There are no blocks in the box
flyingeaves.cmd.export_none: Nothing has been placed with the build tools yet
flyingeaves.cmd.exported_info: %s blocks, %s×%s×%s, %s kinds of block → %s (in a structure block: flyingeaves:%s)
